title: Per-Mile Rate on Kestrel Advantage Balloon Returns for Customers with Other Kestrel Financing
content:
**Relationship pricing — excess mileage rate.** The per-mile rate charged on the excess mileage of a returned Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract is the excess mileage rate for the contract's tier, reduced for customers with other Kestrel financing:

| Customer's other Kestrel financing | Per-mile rate |
|---|---|
| A **Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract** or a **Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract** that has reached paid in full or closed | The tier's excess mileage rate reduced by USD 0.05 per mile |
| No such contract, but an active **Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease** or an active Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract | The tier's excess mileage rate reduced by USD 0.03 per mile |
| Neither | The tier's excess mileage rate |

The records read are the status of the customer's new-vehicle retail contracts, pre-owned retail contracts and leases. A completed contract takes precedence: a customer with both a paid-in-full retail contract and an active lease has the 0.05 reduction, not both reductions.

## Hypothetical cases (tier rate USD 0.25 per mile)

- A closed pre-owned retail contract: USD 0.20 per mile.
- An active lease and nothing completed: USD 0.22 per mile.
- Only a pre-owned retail contract that is still active: USD 0.25 per mile.
